items.raw_excerpt: Norway has earned a reputation of a difficult place to settle and make friends over the years. The Local has put together a guide on essential resources to help you fight loneliness.
items.summary_en: Norway has a name for being a hard place to settle and make friends. A local guide shares five simple tips and useful resources to help newcomers fight loneliness.

items.raw_excerpt: When Gina Saarberg started cooking porridge as a student to save money on food, she could never have guessed that it would take her all the way to a world title. The 28-year-old from Zutphen won the Golden Spurtle at the weekend, the prestigious trophy awarded to the winner of the annual porridge making championships in Carrbridge, Scotland. Saarberg put her success down to the ingredients she used, including pinhead oats from Noord-Brabant company De Halm and water from her...
items.summary_en: Gina Saarberg from Zutphen won the Golden Spurtle at a porridge-making contest in Carrbridge, Scotland. The 28-year-old started cooking porridge as a student to save money. She said her oats and local water helped her win.

items.raw_excerpt: Authorities are concerned about the effect homeschooling can have on a child's educational development as well as their sense of societal belonging.
items.summary_en: Finland is asking whether parents should still be allowed to teach their children at home. Officials worry that homeschooling may hurt a child's learning and their sense of belonging in society. The debate is now a small national talking point.
items.summary_ko: 핀란드에서 부모가 집에서 아이를 가르치는 홈스쿨링을 계속 허용할지 논의가 이어지고 있다. 당국은 홈스쿨링이 아이의 학습과 사회 소속감에 나쁜 영향을 줄 수 있다고 걱정한다. 이 문제는 지금 핀란드에서 작은 화제가 되고 있다.
items.title_en: Should Finland ban homeschooling?

items.raw_excerpt: Con la compra en una verdulería, el Banco Central (BC) dio el vamos a la circulación de la nueva moneda de 50 pesos, que, si bien mantiene el mismo diseño, es ligeramente más liviana: ahora pesa 6,5 gramos en vez de siete. El anuncio lo hicieron la presidenta y la gerenta tesorera del ente emisor, Rosanna Costa y Cecilia Feliú, respectivamente. items.raw_excerpt: Politics professor Lori Williams and her colleagues are among the in-demand speakers as community-based organizations across Alberta plan, host and get creative to help residents understand the referendum's complex questions.

items.raw_excerpt: Have you ever felt you had to order dessert, buy the latest gadget or stay late at work simply because everyone else was doing it? Then you need to know this word.

items.raw_excerpt: Shepherds in the Veluwe region have come up with a novel solution to deter wolf attacks by hiring Italian mountain dogs to guard their sheep. Stichting Schapedrift Ermelo, a volunteer organisation that tends a herd of sheep on the heathlands in Gelderland, acquired two Maremmano-Abruzzese sheepdogs this summer to protect the herd from prowling wolves. The forested Veluwe region has the biggest concentration of wolves in the Netherlands, with seven packs living in an area of 1,000 square kilometr
items.summary_en: Shepherds in the Veluwe region of the Netherlands are using Italian mountain dogs to protect their sheep. A volunteer group got two Maremmano-Abruzzese sheepdogs this summer. The Veluwe has the largest wolf population in the country.
